description: Billing policy knobs that are expected to change without a code release.

fields.description: Grant welcome credits when a team completes its billing profile.
fields.label: Grant Welcome Credits

fields.description: Days a welcome credit stays usable. 0 means it never expires.
fields.label: Validity (Days)

fields.description: Amount granted per currency. A currency with no row gets no credits.
fields.label: Amounts

fields.description: Create every new team as a staging trial — it provisions servers on welcome credits without a full billing profile. For staging deployments.
fields.label: Provision Teams as Trial

fields.description: Days after an invoice opens before it falls due.
fields.label: Due Days

fields.description: How long an invoice may wait for a team's billing details before the operators are paged and the team stops being funded on credit.
fields.label: Billing Details Grace (Days)

fields.description: Warn a team once forecast spend reaches this much of its cap.
fields.label: Spend Warning At

fields.description: Days past due to retry payment on, comma separated.
fields.label: Retry Days

fields.description: Days past due before a subscription is suspended.
fields.label: Suspend After (Days)

fields.description: Days past due before a subscription is terminated.
fields.label: Terminate After (Days)

fields.description: How long a cohort projection may be expected to take before it is refused. This is a production safety limit: raising it is how the bound stops bounding.
fields.label: Projection Budget (Seconds)

fields.description: Rolling window (days) the gateway logs — Payment Attempt and Webhook Event — are kept before daily pruning. Live/unsettled rows are kept regardless.
fields.label: Payment Log Retention (Days)
Daily Snapshot Retention (Hours)
fields.description: How long Central keeps a daily snapshot before it deletes it. A customer can keep one for longer.

fields.label: Free Snapshots per Server
fields.description: The newest snapshots of each server, up to this count, are free. Each older one costs the Snapshot rate in Catalog Rate, per GB per month.

fields.label: Offer Another Rail After a Terminal Decline
fields.description: When a card is finally refused, offer the customer the other gateway once, amount prefilled. Ambiguous failures (timeouts, abandoned 3DS) never fall back whatever this says. Which gateway is primary per currency is the Default flag on Payment Gateway Currency, so it stays in one place.
Output GST rate put on a new Indian team's tax profile.
fields.label: Default GST Rate

fields.description: How old a GSTIN status may get before the daily sweep asks the GST portal again. Invoicing only reads the stored status.
fields.label: GSTIN Status Refresh (Days)

fields.description: Most GSTIN lookups the daily sweep makes. Keeps the GST portal and ERPNext out of harm's way.
fields.label: GSTIN Lookups per Day
Accounting
fields.description: Names Central reads from the accounting system. Central does not create them.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: The company's name in the accounting system.

fields.label: Company Address
fields.description: The company's address in the accounting system. It carries the company GSTIN.

fields.label: Accounts
fields.description: Full account names, for example Debtors - ABBR.

fields.label: Advance Account
fields.description: Where customer advances are booked. The company must book advances in a separate account, this one.

fields.label: Service Item
fields.description: The item on every invoice line. Its SAC code comes from the accounting system.

fields.label: Tax
fields.description: Supplies outside India and to SEZ units are zero-rated and use no template.

fields.label: Naming Series
fields.description: A GST invoice number has 16 characters or fewer: letters, digits, / and -.

fields.label: Receipt Vouchers
fields.description: Numbers the advance received for a wallet top-up.

fields.label: Print Formats
fields.description: Print formats in the accounting system. Invoice PDFs are rendered with them.

name: Billing Settings
